description: Mark establishes that he is Bjarne’s best friend and hints that Bjarne has been unusually quiet.

openingMessages.speaker: Mark
openingMessages.text: Sorry, I didn't have my phone on me, what did you want to talk about?

choices.text: No worries. I was just checking in. How have you been?
Maybe I've turned over a new leaf.
I might need something later. Don't get too comfortable.
I was actually hoping you could remind me what we were talking about.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: You? Checking in on me? Without needing something? Who are you and what have you done with Bjarne?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: I'm good, man. Same old stuff. You know, your best friend is allowed to hear from you every once in a while.

lines.speaker: Pragmatist
lines.text: A best friend! Excellent. We've established a support network without doing any actual work.

choices.text: Can't I just ask how you're doing?
I might be trying to become a better friend.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Right. And I suppose you're going to start replying to messages on time, too? I'll believe it when I see it.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: But seriously, it's nice hearing from you.

choices.text: I thought I'd surprise you. How have you been?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: There it is. Knew there was an ulterior motive.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Alright, what's up? You're still my best friend, even if you are a pain to get hold of.

choices.text: Nothing urgent. I just wanted to talk.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: You called me, man. I missed it.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Sometimes you call your best friend just because you want to talk. Not every conversation needs a five-point agenda.

lines.speaker: Detective
lines.text: He mentioned you called him previously. We should find out why.

choices.text: Right. Of course. Sorry about that.
I must have had something important to say.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Seriously though, everything alright? You've been pretty quiet lately.

lines.speaker: Grand Architect
lines.text: He's clearly concerned. Don't mistake his humor for indifference.

choices.text: Just a lot on my mind.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Yeah, I figured. Listen, whatever it is, you know where to find me.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: That's what you always say. Anyway, I'm around if you need anything.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: ...Well, that's a new one. You usually have an answer for everything.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Maybe that's not necessarily a bad thing.
